notes: An assertion is a planned atomic check, not a completed run or a distinct road case.
No automatic score when an oracle, capability, or fair comparator is missing.
Physical road instrumentation is deferred; simulated sensor data cannot prove field accuracy.
Legally unverified movements and absent lane data are unknown, never automatic pass.
